ac-m.label: Share of Delhi Capitals' balls faced by batters aged twenty-three or under, 2018–2026
ac-m.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
ac-m.query: SELECT pl.name, CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (8,11) OR i.bowling_team_id IN (8,11) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END x, i.batting_team_id bt, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.batter_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2018 AND 2026 GROUP BY pl.name, year, bt
